items.title: Live: Trump says US will hit Iran 'hard again today'
items.description: Speaking to reporters at the White House, the US president claimed Tehran was "playing us for suckers". Follow live.

items.title: Albanese's frustration with Trump is becoming harder to hide
items.description: The Albanese government is paying an economic and political toll for an ongoing and deeply unpopular war.

items.title: SpaceX courts Australian investors as government warns Elon Musk risk
items.description: As tens of thousands of Australians line up to buy shares in Elon Musk's SpaceX blockbuster public offering, Australian government officials are privately flagging the risks of the country's growing reliance on its satellite internet service, Starlink.

items.title: Hundreds protest against Pauline Hanson as WA Labor seats on 'hit list'
items.description: A crowd of roughly 400 protesters demonstrates against One Nation's Pauline Hanson as she speaks at a sundowner event in Perth's eastern suburbs.

items.title: What happens when a gas company abandons an entire city?
items.description: For many, getting off gas and electrifying their homes is a personal choice. But what happens when an entire town is abandoned by a gas company?

items.title: How the Belfast attack played into the hands of Britain's far right
items.description: As UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer fights for his political life, the country is bracing for what could be a yet another summer of unrest.

items.title: Bill Gates 'deeply sorry' for Epstein ties in testimony to US politicians
items.description: The Microsoft co-founder appeared before a closed-door US House Oversight Committee panel that has been investigating the late sex offender's connections with the rich and powerful.

items.title: 'Underground tanning world' still operating despite decade-long ban
items.description: Illegal solariums are operating across the country, from single machines secretly set up in suburban neighbourhood garages to those hidden in the back of legitimate businesses.

items.title: World's biggest whale graveyard found in Indian Ocean off Australia
items.description: Hundreds of whale fossils, including those from extinct species new to science, range in age from recent to five million years old and are also home to undescribed deep-sea creatures.

items.title: Illegal peptides are everywhere. Now authorities are cracking down
items.description: The Therapeutic Goods Administration has launched a crackdown on unregulated peptides, saying increased illegal imports were posing a risk to consumers.

items.title: Gout sixth in Diamond League debut as Olympic champ claims victory
items.description: Gout Gout finishes well back in the field in the men's 200 metres at the Oslo Diamond League meet, with Olympic champion Letsile Tebogo first across the line.

items.title: When does the FIFA World Cup start and who are the favourites?
items.description: The FIFA World Cup is the biggest single-sport event on the planet and has delivered numerous historical moments, from Diego Maradona's "hand of God" in 1986 to Zinedine Zidane's infamous headbutt on Marco Materazzi.

items.title: Senator Wendy Askew won't seek re-election. Liberals, One Nation eye seat
items.description: A Tasmanian senator will not recontest her seat in 2028, meaning it is up for the taking by Liberal colleagues and possibly a resurgent One Nation.

items.title: Victorian town fights high suicide rates with mental health first aid
items.description: After losing a family member to suicide, Peter Taylor vowed to bring mental health first aid to his community.

items.title: In Moldova, I met a woman with a dangerous plan to save her life
items.description: On a park bench in Moldova, I meet a Ukrainian refugee who is planning to return home through a war zone for cancer treatment. We talk for hours.

items.title: Spielberg's Disclosure Day is a close encounter of the hopeful kind
items.description: ET director Steven Spielberg dives back into the extra terrestrial with his latest film while asking 'How do you astonish an audience when anything is possible, and nothing is real?

items.title: How well do you know Aussie books? Take our quiz to find out
items.description: Occupy yourself with some armchair travel courtesy of a selection of our nation's most esteemed literary works.

items.title: Residents say Brisbane's new outer city estates missing crucial service
items.description: Hundreds of thousands of new homes are being built on the outskirts of greater Brisbane. But residents are concerned if one thing doesn't improve, their quality of life will go backwards.

items.title: O'Callaghan chasing Titmus and 'the impossible' as she misses world record
items.description: Mollie O'Callaghan shoots out of the gates in the 200m freestyle but cannot maintain the world record pace as she books her ticket to the Glasgow Commonwealth Games.

items.title: England captain Stokes dropped for second NZ Test over nightclub incident
items.description: The decision to leave both the English captain and bowler Gus Atkinson off the side comes after a reported nightclub incident following the side's win in the first Test.

items.title: Bear attack in Japan car park captured on CCTV as cities record more and more wild encounters
items.description: Bear encounters are rising in Japan, and the problem is not confined to the wilderness.

items.title: High Court decision could lead to tens of millions of dollars worth of immigration claims
items.description: There are warnings a High Court ruling allowing a man to sue for false imprisonment over his indefinite immigration detention will lead to more claims running into the tens of millions of dollars.

items.title: Hong Kong authorities charge seven people over deadly 2025 fire
items.description: The seven people charged included directors and inspectors of a consultancy firm involved in the estate's renovation.

items.title: 'National reluctance' to discuss abuse of Indigenous children, says ex-minister
items.description: A review has begun into the family circumstances of Kumanjayi Little Baby leading up to her disappearance and death, which relatives hope will find answers.

items.title: Twelve dead, nine injured after late-night shooting near Johannesburg
items.description: Police launch a manhunt for more than 10 suspects who launched a late-night attack at the Jumpers informal settlement in the Johannesburg suburb of Cleveland.
